rules.labels: self-labels and labels-by-others live in table/labels.json only. They are never joined into table/functional.json and never used as a field value or a grouping key.

amendments.title: lead-test false-flag rate
amendments.status: STEP 1 RUN 2026-11-24; step 2 applied per its own rule; step 3 in force
amendments.why: amendment A1's calibration returned alpha above the nominal 0.05 (see series/calibration.json). At 200 seeds the 95% interval still includes 0.05, so 200 seeds cannot say whether the test over-flags or the excess is seed noise.
proposal: step 1: rerun the same calibration at 2000 seeds, design otherwise unchanged

step 2, only if the 2000-seed 95% interval excludes 0.05: lower the flag threshold on share_null_ge_observed from 0.05 to the largest value whose calibrated alpha is at most 0.05, and record the new threshold with its calibration
step 3: until A2 is decided, any real flag from the lead test is reported together with the A1 alpha
amendments.outcome: see series/calibration_2000.json: alpha at 2000 seeds, its 95% interval, whether step 2 applied, the threshold in force and the alpha at that threshold. The lead test flags a country only when share_null_ge_observed is at or below the threshold in force. Not applied and noted as an alternative: the (k+1)/(n+1) permutation p-value.

2_tied_year_null.why: v1.2's null redraws as many DISTINCT years as there are events, while a country's events can share a year; the calibration never had shared years
2_tied_year_null.null: keep the tie structure. With k distinct event years carrying multiplicities m_1..m_k, each null draw takes k distinct eligible years and gives the multiplicities to them in random order. Statistic unchanged: mean lead-window stress over events, so a year with m events counts m times. With no shared year this is the v1.2 null, draw for draw.
2_tied_year_null.calibration: noise stress as A1. Events: 6 distinct years drawn from 1970..2023, multiplicities 2,2,1,1,1,1 (8 events). Seeds 20000..21999. Reported at thresholds 0.05 and 0.038 for (i) the v1.2 null applied to tied events, (ii) the tied-year null.

2_tied_year_null.rule: same as item 1, applied to the tied-year null at 0.038. Reported either way.
